verdict: Ads went dark for three days — leads dropped, delivery is being restored.
narrative: This period delivered 77 leads at an average cost of $8.60 per lead, but the last seven days saw a near-complete collapse in lead volume — driven by three consecutive days (Sep 14–16) where paid ads ran at zero spend. Once delivery stopped, leads fell to zero and cost per lead spiked sharply for that window. Spend is being restored and Meta delivery is being brought back to normal pacing. Separately, 79 leads entered your pipeline this period with no appointments and no won opportunities recorded — that points to a gap in how leads are being followed up, which is being addressed on the intake side. You should expect lead volume to recover to prior levels once full daily spend resumes.
